set.tovw: Found: seven $20 gold pieces recovered in May 1906; nothing more said to remain
set.n: Gold coins in a plugged hole in an ash log, Lexington Twp near Le Center (found 1906)
set.pl: GNIS Le Center (village); the Lexington Twp farm is not located
set.st: May 1906: brothers sawing a white-ash log from a Lexington Twp farm found seven $20 gold pieces (latest dated 1854) in a bored, plugged hole. Old settlers tied it to a man lynched at Lexington in 1858-59 for murdering a German land-seeker; nothing more was said to remain. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
